overclaims: The distinctive ingredient, quantity and purpose support describing the answer as a close reworking of that source [e5, e6].
Ars independently reports tracing the glue answer to Reddit and reproducing its illustrated errors.
checks.note: Excerpt, proposition, axis and outcome are fine. Neither evidence item shows what the Reddit comment says. They only say the answer appears to come from it or can be traced to it, so the claimed shared ingredient, quantity and purpose are not shown. The e5 and e6 excerpts are cut to 'Elmer’s glue' and 'traced back', which drops the quantity and what was traced. The e6 explanation calls Ars independent and says it reproduced the errors. But the caption cites another source ('via'), and limitation 4 itself says Ars does not establish it reproduced this answer.
